reviews.text:
A real money pit! The staff is completely dehumanized; you have to wonder if they even like animals.

I've never seen anything like it.

The whole place is drab, sour, sad, even dirty...

The staff systematically tries to charge more than they need, even if it means doing duplicate work; MONEY IS ALL THAT MATTERS.

You have to figure everything out and think for yourself, otherwise you're practically being ripped off!

Since smiles and friendliness are free, there are NO smiles or friendly gestures.

I've been entrusting my two cats to Dr. Saindon for many years now. I'm always very satisfied because he's truly accurate in his diagnoses and incredibly gentle. He shows a lot of empathy, takes the necessary time for each consultation, and explains everything perfectly. A big thank you to him!
Super attentive welcome!
Excellent personal contact and the veterinarian was attentive and competent.
Highly competent and responsive!
Perfect welcome! They took great care of my kitten!
Impeccable as always!!! (40 years of loyalty!!! Long may it continue 🤪...) …

I highly recommend Dr. Lucas, Oumnia's veterinarian. He was absolutely perfect from beginning to end. He took all the time necessary to examine Oumnia, never rushing, and explained everything very clearly with great patience and kindness.

I truly appreciated his professionalism, his attentiveness, and the way he cared for Oumnia. You can tell he loves his job and genuinely cares about the well-being of animals.

Thank you so much to Dr. Lucas for his excellent work and for reassuring me. I recommend him without hesitation! 🐾❤️

Appalling, and they claim to help and care for animals 😞 no animal compassion whatsoever…
Avoid at all costs …
Excellent service, thank you!
Bad experience, €1200 in hospital fees only for my cat to come home in the same condition

Excellent veterinarians, highly competent and friendly to boot.

The reception is very welcoming and the food is varied and of high quality.

Thank you to the whole team.

Sincerely,
A. M. Vinciguerra
My dog ​​and I are always very well received and highly recommend this clinic. (He absolutely insists on going in whenever we're out for a walk: that says it all!). Serious and caring care.
A reputable clinic with attentive veterinarians; Nola feels very comfortable and explores her surroundings. The reception staff are excellent and friendly.

Last Saturday, I had a consultation for a blood test under sedation (€425, including medication). I called the clinic again because my cat's hindquarters have become paralyzed since the sedation. The clinic's response: "Go to another clinic for a scan"... it's outrageous, truly. Prices being higher than other vets in the area, fine—but the service should be up to scratch. Avoid at all costs.

I do not recommend this service to anyone. I paid €150 for the consultation, which included examining my dog ​​and taking its temperature while I waited 3.5 hours for the dog to tremble and walk around.
Hello Ms. Coly, and thank you for your positive feedback.

Everything is perfect, from the welcome to the attention and care given to our cat by Dr. Saindon. Thank you also for the precise advice, which is very helpful.

We had our cat vaccinated last week, and with each visit, we can say again that everything is perfect at this clinic.
Always well received, it's been almost 40 years that they've been following my cats and dogs that I've had over the years, a big thank you to the whole team.
An efficient team and a very good veterinarian, Dr. CANCHON. Friendly welcome.
A warm welcome. Attentive staff who give good advice to the animals. Competent veterinarians. I have been a loyal customer for 20 years.

The veterinary team is very professional, handles my somewhat grumpy cat very well, provides all the necessary explanations, and even the assistants offer good advice. The only downside: the slightly high price.

First visit for our 2-month-old puppy, and everything went very well. The welcome and examination with Dr. Saindon were outstanding, thanks to his availability, attentiveness, and helpful advice. We are very happy and thoroughly enjoyed our visit.

I'm extremely satisfied with this veterinary clinic and a huge thank you for the warm welcome. The kindness and smiles of the medical team were very comforting to me and my 11-month-old cat...it was very convenient for me because of its proximity and the quick appointment booking process.

A huge thank you also to Dr. Pegard who took care of her for a few moments. 😻👍
Top-notch clinic. Very welcoming staff and the vets are not only professional but also very caring towards the animals.
As a long-time client, I have complete confidence in the veterinary team at the practice, and especially in Dr. Saindon.

My three dogs have been going to this clinic for several years and everything is going very well. We have our regular vet, but we've also had the opportunity to see others, even for late-night emergencies, and everything has always gone very smoothly. I trust them completely.
Friendly welcome. And very professional.
Very welcoming and excellent care for my pet

The vets are very competent and attentive to the animal.

They saved my cat 🐱.
The clinic is open 24/7, which is invaluable in an emergency.
We have been clients for many years for our two cats. All the veterinarians are very competent and handle the animals gently and kindly.

I just left the clinic. My dog ​​was pricked six times for a blood test, all unsuccessful, at a cost of 375 euros that I didn't pay. The work wasn't done. Avoid this place; they're not real vets, just apprentices. I'm thinking of running away. Don't take your animals there.

Thank you for this wonderful experience with our new dwarf chinchilla rabbit, who quickly had his first check-up and vaccination without any stress.

I was a little apprehensive about this appointment since I adopted this rabbit at Easter.
My 6-year-old daughter was there; she was able to ask questions and help the vet remove the injection.
Two weeks after Benny's neutering, he's doing much better and better. He recovered so quickly, we were so relieved!
Now we have two males at home, which was unexpected, but we'll soon be able to arrange a meeting between Benny and Ramses, our first lop rabbit!

I highly recommend this establishment. Thank you to the whole team!
Dr. Gayet was very diplomatic and gentle with Dorie, who was stressed. I received all the necessary explanations, and Dorie received the necessary care.
Perfect!

Always a very warm welcome and excellent advice. My 16.8-year-old wirehaired dachshund has been seen by Dr. Gayet there since we got him as a puppy. We were also very well referred to a specialist clinic, EiffelVet, after successful surgery when he was diagnosed with cancer, during the Covid pandemic. He has been in remission ever since, but he is now an older dog with the challenges of old age, which the clinic helps us manage so he can have a good quality of life.
We continue to provide veterinary care and follow-up for our young 1-year-old miniature wirehaired dachshund, Akaï, who has taken the place of Dody in our hearts after he passed away at 17.2 years old.

We had a very good experience at the Place des Fêtes clinic with our two cats. Dr. Canchon is truly attentive to animals and has excellent rapport with owners. Thank you for the time you dedicated to our discussions.
Excellent clinic! Thank you to Dr. Gayet! He is very attentive, explains everything clearly, and most importantly, his treatment really helped.
Excellent vet for my rabbit Filou! I highly recommend them!

Always a very warm welcome from the friendly reception team, and

the consultations are conducted with professionalism. Our little companions are in good hands.
I highly recommend this clinic.

The vets are very efficient, offer good advice, and are lovely. The reception staff are very pleasant and attentive; it's a place you want to return to. In fact, my dog ​​wants to go in every time we walk by :)

I consulted this clinic in an emergency this winter for a cat I had just adopted. From the very first appointment, Dr. Verrot created a reassuring atmosphere and provided highly professional care.
The diagnosis (suspected FIP, quickly confirmed by further tests) was made with clear explanations, which was crucial during this anxious time.
This was followed by an 84-day treatment, demanding for both the cat and me. Throughout this period, I could count on attentive monitoring, reassuring check-ups, and above all, great availability. Dr. Verrot always took the time to answer my many questions with patience, attentiveness, and empathy. A huge thank you also to the veterinary assistants for their kindness, availability, and gentleness with my little feline, who, it must be said, is a real sweetheart 🐱
Today, he's one year old and doing well; he's regained all his joy and curiosity. It's the best possible outcome.
I recommend this clinic without hesitation for the quality of their care and the compassionate support they provide.
Thank you to the whole team!
The reception was excellent and the veterinarians are very competent. My elderly cat receives excellent care there.

The clinic team was able to take in my cat, who was suffering from respiratory failure, as an emergency case last January. The veterinarians not only performed all the necessary examinations but also ensured his transfer to the intensive care unit at the Maison Alfort Veterinary School. Thanks to the team's excellent care and responsiveness, my cat's pyothorax was detected and treated in time, despite his critical condition. I also noted the great compassion of the entire team; during his four days of hospitalization, I was able to spend long periods with him and benefit from very supportive care. I also appreciated the cleanliness of the facilities and the care given to the hospitalized animals (and the resident cat). Communication between the teams ensured optimal care and precise follow-up. The veterinarians made sure to check in remotely throughout his intensive care and afterward, communicating with the teams at Alfort. The rates and quotes were always provided to me upfront with exemplary transparency and professionalism, with a thorough assessment of the relevance of the proposed examinations and treatments. The clinic now cares for my cat. Words cannot express my gratitude; thank you.
Excellent clinic, top-notch vet, very attentive and patient with the animal. I highly recommend it. The reception staff are wonderful. A special mention to Dr. Saindon for his professionalism.
Perfect 👍 …
Too business-oriented
Excellent service. Attentive professionals.

This is the third time I've taken my dog ​​to this clinic, and each time I've received the warmest of welcomes. I've never experienced such comprehensive and caring care for my pet. It's wonderful to see competence combined with kindness and a smile!
Excellent veterinary clinic!

The staff are incredibly caring towards your animals; they do everything they can to make their lives more comfortable, and if that's not possible and they have to help them pass away manually, they are very understanding. They give you all the time you need to say goodbye to your pet and do everything they can to comfort the families. I can't thank them enough for everything they did for my dog. ❤️🕊️
Still at the top for fifteen years. I have six cats...
My dog ​​has always been seen by Dr. Canchon, my previous one too, and it's great!
Excellent clinic, the reception staff are very friendly, and the veterinarians are competent and efficient (our cat is "followed up" with great care and professionalism by Camille Duchêne).
Thank you for your positive feedback!

Open 24/7.
A veterinarian who listens to both the animal and the owner.
He's been my vet for over 15 years 😊 …

My cat has been a patient at this clinic for almost 16 years, and I greatly appreciate having it close to home. The staff has always been attentive, from the receptionists to the various veterinarians who have cared for my cat. A lasting relationship of trust has developed. And they always offer excellent advice for the well-being of our animals!

A team radiating positive energy and good humor. The veterinarian was attentive, calm, patient, clear, and precise. They took the time to answer all our numerous questions. Royal, stay just as you are. We will definitely be back.

I was given a very quick emergency appointment, close to closing time, as the on-call vet was sick and unavailable.

The advice was very helpful, and the vet took the time to call me back the next day to check on me.

Everything was perfect, thank you.

Whatever you do, don't go to that clinic! I paid an astronomical amount for an operation! He was in a completely debilitated state; I almost lost him. And the hygiene is appalling. They clearly don't care about animals except for the money. 🤬 …
Thank you, Ms. Chalal, for this positive feedback.
We warmly thank the entire veterinary team for the excellent care they provided for our cat.
Hello Mr. Tabaksmann and thank you for this positive feedback.
A huge thank you to the entire team who cared for our cat Cooky and then supported him throughout his life with competence, kindness, and such compassion. We are deeply grateful.
We’ve had great experiences here and they have taken excellent care of our dog
I had to deal with an emergency with my cat in the evening because he developed a fever, and everything was taken care of very quickly without any waiting... which reassured me.

From the moment they arrived until the medical procedure, there was great kindness shown to both owner and patient. Piou, a loyal European Shorthair cat of six years, is always reassured, pampered, and well cared for. Thank you to the entire team at the clinic.
Thank you, Ms. Garnero, for your positive feedback.

Excellent clinic! We had an appointment with Mr. Saindon.

He received us warmly and clearly explained what our dog was suffering from.

I highly recommend them.

Everything is perfect, as always! Everyone's kindness, understanding, and connection with my little girl... the feeling that she's always in good hands with excellent, readily available professionals. Everyone is always so patient. Thank you so much for everything and for my little girl!

The entire team at the clinic is fantastic. My cat has received excellent care since his fall; all the professionals have been incredibly accommodating and attentive, both during the initial crisis and for the follow-up care afterwards. I highly recommend them!

I haven't had the chance to visit, but I want to commend this clinic for taking in an unidentified cat, likely hit by a car. Brought in by firefighters in critical condition, the cat received initial treatment at this clinic before a rescue organization took over. Thank you to the staff and veterinarians who cared for him.

Hello Ms. Christelle Fauche,
Thank you for your positive feedback.

Veterinarians who only think about their own profit at the expense of animal suffering.

Even though it's barely 8 PM, they're already charging exorbitant base prices, plus an increased rate after that time, for medicated food essential for the animals' recovery.

It's utterly shameful.

RESPONSE TO THE VET: Since your time is precious for the well-being of animals, please don't waste it on endless sales pitches.

Hello Coucy M,
Thank you for this positive review.
Hello Aurelia Aldumitri and thank you for this positive review.
Always well received at the emergency department of this clinic. Quality care.

A wonderful experience at this clinic, which I was visiting for the first time for an emergency!
The vet who saw my 15-year-old cat was absolutely lovely and quickly put her at ease. He was very gentle during the examination and reassuring about her health.
Thank you for taking such good care of our pets; I will definitely be back! ☺️

My clinic since 2007, which says it all. I'm extremely happy with it. I currently have four cats, three of whom are very old, and the care they provide is very thorough, but not overly aggressive. Yes, the treatments are expensive, especially for animals over 16, but that's the going rate because there's no national health insurance.

The reception, both in person and on the phone, is excellent; the veterinary assistants are fantastic!
Stopped in for an urgent follow-up consultation. I received a very warm welcome; the staff was very pleasant and competent. Thank you again for your kindness. Happy holidays. Caroline and Jack

We have been going to this clinic for almost 10 years. Our two cats are treated there.

We are extremely satisfied with the care provided, as well as the warm welcome and kindness of everyone.
Our cats are seen by Dr. Gayet, but when he is unavailable, we are equally well seen by other veterinarians at the clinic. We have complete confidence in this establishment and have never been disappointed. Quite the opposite, in fact.

We highly recommend it.
Thank you all.
We received a warm welcome and good communication with the young veterinarian, Dr. Pegard, who saw us. He ruled out ringworm after all the tests he performed.
Excellent clinic, welcoming and friendly, with competent veterinarians.
Thank you Maryline for this 5-star review
Thank you Jules for this 5-star review
Thank you, Madam, for your feedback!
Efficient at scheduling appointments, attentive to the animal, takes the necessary time, clear and professional.
Thank you, Ms. Debaye

Excellent vet for an emergency… very kind and patient!
The consultation is obviously expensive on a Sunday evening, but that's the case everywhere for emergencies.
Thank you Anna for your positive feedback!

I went to this clinic twice, the first time just for a check-up, which went well, and the second time for an emergency last Sunday evening. My cat, Tuki, had a very red eye and was clearly unwell.
The emergency service was extremely unpleasant, and the price was completely unjustified because the vet did nothing to find the cause or make Tuki feel better. Her approach was incredibly rude.
I absolutely do NOT recommend this clinic for an emergency. I paid 284 euros and my cat is still sick. It's a disgrace.

Go there without hesitation! The reception staff are lovely and attentive. The veterinarian is also very attentive and genuinely concerned about your pet's well-being. He takes the time to explain things to you, reassure you, and, most importantly, thoroughly examine your pet without rushing them.
One thing is for sure: if I need to take my cat to the vet again, I will definitely come to you.
Thank you again to the whole team.

Availability and professionalism
Thank you to Dr. Cadre

Excellent service and professionalism.
Dr. Grange took the time to examine me and explain everything. I recommend him without hesitation.
Serious professionals and a high-quality welcome
From the reception staff to the veterinarian, the entire team is friendly and professional. I highly recommend them. Thank you all for what you do.
Thank you very much for this review.
Hello and thank you for this positive feedback.
It's a great clinic, with very long opening hours and a caring and competent team.
Very good clinic

My rabbit was refused a consultation at the beginning of last week (she was in transit, and there were available slots on the website), even though she had been a patient at this clinic for eight years. Apparently, she was too old and therefore not profitable enough for the future. Ultimately, my rabbit died at another veterinary clinic I found in an emergency. And the clinic's response four months later only reinforced my initial opinion, demonstrating their bad faith: "For your information, exotic animal consultation slots were available online. Twice I booked one, and twice you declined. I never asked for euthanasia, only an emergency consultation because my rabbit had stopped eating. In fact, my rabbit wasn't euthanized but taken to another clinic, which provided emergency care, despite which she died. Time played a role, including the time I wasted contacting you first, having trusted you for eight years. A little decency and honesty in your statements would be appreciated!"
Very well received, very professional

Thank you, Ms. Chase.
We are delighted that you are satisfied with our services.

The veterinarians are attentive and available in emergencies. The clinic is clean and modern, test results are available the same day, and they respect appointment times, which is rare in the medical field. Thank you to the entire team.

I am disappointed with this veterinary clinic on Place des Fêtes in the 19th arrondissement. They misled me. The vets are young and inexperienced, and since Thursday evening, they've been making me believe they were ordering a treatment to cure the FIP (feline infectious peritonitis) of my 6-month-old kitten who died this morning, October 29, 2025. There is a treatment for FIP that is 80% successful, but it needs to be started immediately. They did absolutely nothing at this clinic; they never received the test results, did nothing at all, and they are demanding 1200 euros in total (hospitalization fees and a FIP treatment that is supposedly prepared in Paris at a pharmacy, which they never received and never administered to my cat 🐱. They should have done it immediately and started it right away). They misled me, did nothing for a Chartreux cat that I paid 1200 euros for. The breeder paid for the kitten, but it only lived for six months. I am extremely angry with this clinic, which didn't even do everything possible to save my kitten, nothing at all. I'm furious, and they haven't even offered any compensation. They want me to pay for treatment they never received and never administered to this poor, lively six-month-old kitten who just wanted to live. I do not recommend this veterinary clinic.
Hello Paul Romain and thank you for your positive feedback!
Thank you so much Josiane Stepho for this great rating!

My little dog loves this clinic. The vets are fantastic, and the receptionists are always smiling and available. I've even called in the evenings or on weekends because I panic very easily whenever my little dog seems strange, and there's always someone there to listen.

Hello Jean-Christophe Guibout,
Thank you for this very positive review!
Excellent clinic with top-notch vets!
Thank you for your positive feedback!

I consulted Dr. Saindon for my Oriental kitten.
He listened attentively and had a reassuring approach to animals. I highly recommend him. He gave excellent advice and was able to diagnose the problem immediately.
The reception was top-notch, so don't hesitate to consult him for your pet.
Ciro has been a patient at this clinic for years, and we are still delighted with them. The veterinary team is kind, attentive, and very caring. I recommend them without hesitation.
Hello and thank you for this review!
Thank you for your positive feedback!
Our cat received excellent care. Professionalism, kindness, and empathy were all present. Thank you again.

I went in this morning to buy two tablets for my dog. I asked for adult tablets, but as soon as I left, I saw puppy tablets. I came back because it wasn't working. A refund of €10 was impossible; I had to haggle. What a sad experience to be treated like that! This veterinary clinic is to be avoided; money is all they care about. Luckily, I have an older vet who is great. He loves animals, and as for his prices, if you think it's expensive, he says so, and I'll cut it in half. He's fantastic. At the Place des Fêtes clinic, I paid with a €10 note, and they gave me my €10 in coins. You can see their level of love for money, but avoid them for animals!
Veterinary clinic open 24/7, very conveniently accessible by public transport or car. Attentive staff and veterinarians.
Very professional. I recommend.
Very welcoming, the vet was very attentive, and thanks to the team's quick response, my little one was saved.

Excellent veterinary clinic.
My cat has been a patient there for three and a half years.
Thank you to the whole team for the warm welcome and for the quick appointments available online or directly in person.
Unwavering gratitude 🙏🙏 …
Hello Ms. Berger, and thank you for your positive feedback. It encourages us to continue with care and passion!
Thank you for the positive review! Give Gripoil a pat.
Attentive and passionate team
Excellent service. They take very good care of the animals and are particularly skilled in handling them gently and with respect.
Answers the phone very quickly, thank you so much for everything!

We have had our dog Leya treated several times for various emergencies, most recently at the end of August. The veterinarians have always been very welcoming, doing everything necessary to diagnose Leya and provide her with the appropriate care. Furthermore, the clinic is responsive, even at night and on weekends, despite the high volume of emergencies.
I called because my pet needs to be put down, and they told me I need to make an appointment. It's supposedly an emergency service.

As a client for five years, I have always been satisfied with the basic care and routine veterinary procedures performed on my dog.

However, my recent experience with a more complex problem was disappointing.

My dog ​​had an abscess and a wound on his paw. He was sedated so the vet could examine and remove a foreign object. The vet sedated my dog ​​and removed a small fragment resembling a foxtail. However, the very next day, while disinfecting the wound, I was able to remove the entire foxtail myself—clearly visible, but that's beside the point. I tried to contact the vet: the telephone reception was unfriendly, my message didn't seem to be taken seriously, and my email went unanswered. I simply wanted advice on how to proceed with my dog's health, but I haven't received any response. It's been a week.

Fortunately, my dog ​​seems to be doing better now, but this care leaves much to be desired. I only recommend this practice for simple or preventative care. For more complex situations, I will now look for another veterinarian.
A team of passionate and efficient veterinarians and assistants. I highly recommend them! They will take excellent care of your animals ;-)
Excellent vets, very gentle with our animals. Prices aren't cheap, but the quality is there.

Hello and thank you for your very positive feedback!
The clinic team

Excellent experience during my numerous consultations (2 elderly cats with multiple health conditions), both scheduled appointments and emergencies. Attentive and competent staff. Special mention for Dr. Cadre, who was exceptional.

I went today, June 27th at 9:30 am. I presented a prescription from the Dispensary Assistance Foundation for medication because I couldn't find it in the pharmacy. It's on order and it's urgent for my cat who is going to have an operation. The lady at the reception told me that I wouldn't sell it to you because the prescription didn't come from us. I begged her, but she refused.
A team of professionals, and very friendly to boot; we highly recommend this Veterinary Clinic

A fantastic team! I wholeheartedly recommend the Place des Fêtes Veterinary Clinic. The welcome is always warm, the premises are clean and reassuring, and above all, Dr. Saindon, who has been treating our cat Miya for six years now, demonstrates great attentiveness, kindness, and professionalism (thank you for the recommendation of boiled zucchini: Miya has loved it since she was a kitten!). A huge thank you for your dedication and compassion!
Thank you so much for your 5-star review! It's essential to us that you're happy with your visit to the clinic. See you soon, and thank you for your trust 🐾 …

Excellent clinic!

I went there for my kitten. The receptionist was lovely and attentive, and I highly recommend the veterinarian, Mr. Gayet—gentle, kind, and always smiling. Professional, I will definitely be back.

Dr. Gayet has always been there for my cats Bagheera, Baloo, and Tara. His advice and the attention he and the entire team have given them make this clinic highly recommended. Top-notch care, a friendly and attentive welcome—I highly recommend this place to anyone who wants their pet to be cared for in the best possible way.

Excellent veterinary clinic that treated my cat for a complete tooth extraction. The pre-operative consultation was perfect, with a clear explanation of the procedure (complete with photos), and a precise quote to avoid any unpleasant surprises. Their prices are also listed on their website, giving you an idea of ​​the cost before the consultation.
On the day of the surgery, they called to confirm that everything had gone well, which reassured me while I waited to pick him up at the end of the day. Dr. Gayet is very kind and patient; he even called me a week later to check on my cat and give me the results of his blood test. I wholeheartedly recommend this clinic for the care of our four-legged friends!

Run away! They prey on your desperation to squeeze as much money out of you as possible, and with no results to show for it. If you care about your animals, don't even set foot in there.
RUN AWAY!

My cat died at their clinic, and they told me with a smile. Avoid this crooked vet! They charged €600 for an emergency related to a fall, but when I arrived, they didn't see any treatment for the broken leg, nor did they clean it. They did absolutely nothing. In short, RUN!

My cat died because of this clinic. He had all the symptoms of feline diabetes, but they completely misled us. They charged us for tons of tests under the guise of "further analysis," even though all the other vets said they should have known it was diabetes just from the symptoms. The result: six months of tests administered to my already very weak cat, all for nothing, only to be unable to save him at the last minute when the diabetes diagnosis was finally confirmed. RUN AWAY!!

I found the receptionist at the entrance very friendly. This assistant even kindly printed out the insurance forms for the consultation. The consultation itself was conducted by an efficient veterinarian. However, I found her a bit judgmental regarding observations, admittedly true, about the care I take in brushing my Maine Coon's fur and the cleanliness of her ears. It was a rather harsh reprimand, but one that has allowed me to take better care of my cat. Let's just say that not everyone is cut out for tact. Tests had to be done, and since several injections were required, I suspected that the first vial would have had plenty of time to coagulate, which it did. So, part of the results are irrelevant. Of course, I wasn't charged for it. Then, to conclude the consultation, even though the available blood test results were perfect, I was told that I might need to be wary of my Caats grain-free cat food. Since my cat's tests were perfect, I let it go while listening to the spiel about veterinary brands. I spent almost €300. I know some vets have lower rates, but there was a battery of tests. In short, a good clinic, but I don't know if I would choose it as my regular clinic in the future; only time will tell.

Hello,

We have taken note of your feedback and are sorry to hear that your experience was not satisfactory.

Without an accompanying comment or a name associated with a file at our clinic, it is unfortunately difficult for us to understand what the problem may have been during your visit.

We invite you to contact us directly to discuss this further. This will allow us to better understand your experience and, if necessary, improve our services.

Our veterinary clinic remains available 24/7 for emergencies, with the quality of care for animals and support for owners as our top priorities.

I went to the clinic on April 13th around 2:45 PM. I explained that my dog ​​had howled twice and was having trouble breathing. The vet put my dog ​​on oxygen in a cage. She saw us at 6:00 PM because she was alone. When I got to her office, she told me it was either neurological or pulmonary. I asked her if she had done any tests. Nothing had been done, no x-rays or blood work. I had told her that she had had blood work done in January, and everything was fine. Given this, I made the decision to leave with my dog. I found a vet who was willing to take her, and in one hour, x-rays and blood work were done. The conclusion was that she had pulmonary edema. If I hadn't made this decision, I would have lost my dog. And the clinic is asking me for €130 for 3 hours of oxygen! I do not recommend this clinic.
Pleasant welcome and professional team! This is my second visit to this clinic and I am satisfied!
Appointments with virtually no waiting time, and reliable vets our pets trust. 😉 And thank you for the excellent advice. 🐾😻 …

A superb team, welcoming staff, and animal health professionals. My cats obviously don't like going there; I don't think they'd agree with me, but they appreciate the quality of life they have thanks to the excellent care they receive.

I have been taking my first cat, and now my second, to the Place des Fêtes veterinary clinic for 23 years and I am completely satisfied. I have a regular vet, but in his absence I have consulted other vets, and again I have been entirely satisfied and have complete confidence in them.
Always available, careful, and gentle, the various professionals at this veterinary center are excellent. I've been going there for 8 years for my cat and rabbit.
A very positive experience with Dr. Heid
I'm still shocked by these vets' prices!! It's absolutely outrageous to charge between €100 and €300 every time; it's infuriating and shameful!!!
A disastrous experience! I strongly advise against going there; it's obvious that the well-being of animals is not the driving force behind this practice...

Incompetent practice.

My dog ​​died on December 25, 2024. She had a breathing problem, and we were told that as soon as her condition worsened, they had a solution to help her breathe better and thus prevent her death. But no solution was implemented. The veterinarian watched my dog ​​die before his eyes without putting in place the solution he had in mind.

Furthermore, she was scheduled for surgery, and during the few days she was at their practice, NO ONE called the hospital in Créteil to schedule an emergency appointment, even though her condition was deteriorating daily, or even to find an animal transporter with oxygen.
I DO NOT RECOMMEND THEM!!
Competent and available veterinarians. Quick appointments. You can trust them. Consultations by appointment and 24/7 emergency service. I am very satisfied with their service.

IMPOSTERS

This veterinary clinic is a complete sham! They only care about their profits, not the well-being of the animals. I've brought my cat in several times, and today is the height of indecency!
